title: Subscription trial outcomes
bodyMd:
Trials are assigned to one package. Conversion means beginning a paid subscription within 14 days of trial expiry.

| Category | Expired trials | Paid conversions |
|---|---:|---:|
| Audio | 100 | 30 |
| Video | 200 | 90 |
| Combined | 300 | 120 |
